audience: developers and ops teams who generate PDFs and images with APITemplate.io

useCases.title: See which templates you have saved
useCases.text: The AI lists your PDF and image templates with id, name, format and group, and reads the HTML and CSS of a PDF template.

useCases.title: Check how many generations you have left
useCases.text: The AI reads your quota: generations allowed, used and remaining, plus the template count. Check it before a big batch.

useCases.title: Review the files you generated
useCases.text: The AI lists generated PDFs and images, newest first, with template, type, your meta reference and the hosted file URLs.

useCases.title: Generate a PDF or image from a template
useCases.text: The AI fills a saved template with your JSON data, or changes the layers of an image template, and returns the hosted download URL.

useCases.title: Turn HTML, Markdown or a web page into a PDF
useCases.text: The AI renders a PDF from HTML or Markdown with placeholders filled from data, or prints a public web page, and returns the download URL.

useCases.title: Merge several PDFs into one
useCases.text: The AI joins 2 to 20 PDFs from public URLs, in the order you give, and returns the URL of the merged PDF. The source files stay unchanged.
